content: I would recommend doing step 12 before this one. That way, you'll have the new piece ready when this one is removed. So you won't need to prop up the bed while doing step 12.
For anyone that put the parts side by side before discarding the old one, my old one was labeled "E2", where the new one is labeled "x E1", and taller than the old one

replies.content: Batch 1.5 INDX and mine is labeled x E1 as well.

content: If you have the 8T, you can stack both nozzle boxes to support the bed.

replies.content: thanks! that was a perfect fit

content: In my opinion it makes more sense to perform the next step first (insert the nuts into the new part). Otherwise you have a bed hanging from the front while you add the nuts. If you did it before you can just continue.
INDX + GEN 2 UPGRADE: Once the motors are unplugged and the left panel and cover are removed, return to the Prusa INDX guide step REMOVING THE REAR BED SPACER, and continue from there.
